english.note: Use this as the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the physical surface of the Earth.

exampleSentences.english: The ground is still wet after the rain.
exampleSentences.jyutping: lok6 jyun4 jyu5 dei6 min6 zung6 mei6 gon1

english.note: Use this for the ground or land surface, rather than an indoor floor or a building storey.

exampleSentences.english: When hiking, the forest floor is very slippery.
exampleSentences.traditional: 行山嗰陣，森林嘅地面好跣。
exampleSentences.jyutping: haang4 saan1 go2 zan6 sam1 lam4 ge3 dei6 min6 hou2 sin2

english.note: Use this when “deck” means the ground or floor that someone falls or lies on.

exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 dit3 zo2 hai2 dei6 min6 dou6
